notes: Adds an explicit profile permission 'Can carry out instructor-led training'. Department Manager remains the automatic responsible owner for whole-site instructor-led training. Managers/Admins may always deliver; a User/Supervisor with this profile permission may deliver training for people in their own Department(s) without receiving full Manager access. The permission is available in People & Access for shared accounts and Safety-only accounts. Manual responsibility override remains available and may target authorised Training Instructors. Includes v2.11.56 responsibility, v2.11.55 Groups and v2.11.54 one-login/cache recovery.
